known_limitations.description: Decision can repeat a visible rejected effective request; current T=1 profile recovery stability is untested.
known_limitations.current_mitigation: Shared Guard rejection + one bounded same-iteration replacement + cumulative invalid iteration stop.
known_limitations.observed_evidence: Prior T=0 strict-json-schema method_002: 5 duplicate rejections / invalid_action_limit despite full canonical feedback. Latest T=1 run has no rejection, so does not validate recovery.
known_limitations.planned_next_validation: Separate authorized fixed 8-case stability / saved failure-State comparison; not run by snapshot.

known_limitations.description: Projector can return structurally valid extraction with empty proposed support; source Integrity cannot invent omitted semantic support.
known_limitations.current_mitigation: Typed/domain/source validation, scoped group repair/fallback, PRE/POST diagnostics, support monotonicity.
known_limitations.observed_evidence: Historical structural trace confirms upstream empty FACT assertions plus a distinct domain rejection repaired for MECHANISM; no silent converter support loss found. That older T=0 run is not a frequency measurement for current profile.
known_limitations.planned_next_validation: Evaluate support establishment with current profile separately, using existing PRE/POST metadata.

known_limitations.description: complete/partial and relevance/entailment are model semantic judgments without independent current E2 validation.
known_limitations.current_mitigation: Deterministic IDs, provenance, actual citations, selected-support mapping; no program claim of semantic completeness.
known_limitations.observed_evidence: AnswerSemanticDraft uses complete/partial; compiler only checks allowed support and citations. SemanticAnswerJudge is Protocol/DTO only.
known_limitations.planned_next_validation: Calibrated independent E2/human semantic validation in a separate task.

known_limitations.description: qwen38_recommended has only a successful single method_002 observation, not a full stability/40-case production baseline.
known_limitations.current_mitigation: Run manifests, frozen Golden, exact request audits; distinguish candidate config from validated quality.
known_limitations.observed_evidence: Latest manifest case_count=1; current-profile fixed 8-case and 40-case have not been run.
known_limitations.planned_next_validation: Separate authorized stability suite before formal 40-case.

known_limitations.description: Semantic near-duplicates remain legal when canonical retrieval-relevant inputs differ.
known_limitations.current_mitigation: Exact canonical identity dedup + no-progress/targeted-support hints.
known_limitations.observed_evidence: Guard compares identities; regression test explicitly permits semantic-near-duplicate distinct requests. No semantic detector implemented.
known_limitations.planned_next_validation: Measure redundant strategies separately; no forced semantic detector in current production.

known_limitations.description: Sending strict=true does not prove the provider enforces every Schema keyword or prevents semantic omission.
known_limitations.current_mitigation: Local Pydantic/domain validation, Runtime Guard, bounded repairs/fallback.
known_limitations.observed_evidence: Older strict requests still produced empty query/local Schema rejection; current one-case success is not enforcement proof. Native request metadata now independently verified offline.
known_limitations.planned_next_validation: Provider/schema reliability study separately, without removing local validation.
